Scrapers that adapt automatically when a source changes, and still return a verdict in 300ms, is a nice bit of engineering underneath the fraud detection.

I built Canopy, which parses a repo across 10 languages into a deterministic call graph and marks unresolved calls external instead of guessing: https://canopy-v7hb.onrender.com

I'm a 2027 CS grad looking for an internship. Any engineering roles open at InfoHawk right now?

Patrick was the first engineer at FunCraft, shipping multiple mobile games with 1M+ downloads and building scalable shared codebases. We've worked together since 2017, including co-leading multiple teams at Zynga as PM & Tech Lead respectively. The opportunity is massive - there are 80M US personal tax returns filed via professionals annually, in a $2B outsourcing market where individual CPA firms currently pay $100k-$1M per year for inferior services. We're positioned to capture significant market share by offering better accuracy & document coverage, instant processing, and superior user experience. We've built this kind of software before, we've worked together for years (and even lived together)

Experience with Next.js or Vite, asyncpg, connection pooling, PgBouncer, index tuning, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, task retries, idempotency, dead-letter queues, rate limiting, Flower, multi-stage Dockerfiles, Nginx WebSocket upgrade headers, gzip, PM2, log rotation, Playwright, GitHub Actions CI/CD, RBAC or CORS is useful. This is an in-office role based in Delhi. For queries, contact connect@helpstir.in.

email.body:
Hi Helpstir team,

Matching people who need help with verified NGOs and CSR funders means the backend has to keep every party's data separate and trustworthy.

I built MedVault, a Django REST backend with per-user data isolation at the queryset level and a Gemini pipeline that returns a fixed JSON schema instead of free text: https://medvault-xor.vercel.app

I'm a 2027 CS grad looking for an internship or entry-level role. Still hiring for the full stack engineer position?

bb5c0a5b1c.description: Team size: 4. The app platform inside Claude and ChatGPT. Floot is the layer where vibecoded software runs. SaaS is dead. Hundreds of millions of people already spend their day in Claude or ChatGPT - and increasingly, when they need an app, they won't buy one. They'll describe it, and it will exist. We're building the infrastructure that makes that real. When Claude creates an app, it needs somewhere for that app to live: a backend, a database, hosting, a domain, the ability to scale, various services, maybe even to be able to work as a mobile app. Floot is that place - a full stack purpose-built for AI to operate, from a specialized framework that defines how AI writes and runs code, down to scalable hosting on AWS. This means you can now build and ship real apps directly inside Claude and ChatGPT. Connect Floot, and the model you already pay for writes and debugs the code, shows a live preview, and publishes to your own domain. No need to wire up git, vercel, supabase and a dozen other providers. And no AI credits - every message runs on the subscription you already have, because we charge for the platform, not for a token markup. We built Floot this way because we've watched the model layer commoditize - every serious builder writes good code now, including us. The lasting value isn't another agent between you and the model. It's the layer underneath, from wherever people already are. bd105abe64.description: Warum LPE Immobilien? Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel. Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren. Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam. Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst Fullstack in TypeScript , vom Kundenportal über das Verwaltercockpit bis zu den Services und der Infrastruktur dahinter, auf der grünen Wiese und ohne Altlasten. Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite. Du baust KI-Agenten als Produktfunktionalität für unsere Verwalter und Kunden. Zugleich entwickeln wir unsere eigene Entwicklungsumgebung permanent weiter: ein modernes Setup rund um Cursor und Claude Code, inklusive Agent-Graph-Loops und Harness. Dabei arbeitest du nah an den Nutzern : Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg. Wir sammeln Probleme, bewerten sie und bauen die wichtigsten in festen Cycles. Unser Stack : TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. Du musst nicht alles davon kennen, den Rest

email.body:
Hi xPay team,

Abstracting away compliance and remittance so SaaS merchants don't have to touch it themselves means the backend has to handle sensitive billing data carefully.

MedVault does something similar on the data side: a Django REST backend with per-user isolation at the queryset level and JWT auth with refresh-token rotation: https://medvault-xor.vercel.app

I'm a 2027 CS grad looking for an internship. Any room for that on a 3-person team?

Today, Explorex powers 250+ partner restaurants and 3M+ diners across Bangalore and Hyderabad, processing 8M+ transactions annually (18M+ lifetime), and operates at breakeven.
